'''2018 MPC Kyle Krueger LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kyle Krueger]] at [[2018 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Kyle Krueger]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 Match Play Championship]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
